_note: Exploratory evidence catalogue. Only SNPs with weight > 0 affect the score. weight 1.0 on a single scored SNP is a normalisation, not a measured effect size. Additive allele counting is an assumption.

panel.weight_source: normalisation (single scored SNP); not an effect size
panel.evidence: G (Ala12) protective, C (Pro12) risk-direction. Meta-analyses: PMID 22527903 (He 2012), PMID 22564702 (OR 0.75 for Ala), PMID 23748472 (Indian, 450 cases/300 controls, G vs C OR 0.55 reported); PMC4694232 (updated meta-analysis, G protective, CG vs CC OR 0.79). PMID 26770332 not confirmed.
panel.conflicts: Single studies null or opposite (US cohort PMC1925257 null; Egyptian PMID 28698741 reported higher G in cases, unconfirmed). Effect modest and population-dependent.
panel.note: Rechecked from independent search results; direction consistent across meta-analyses.

panel.weight_source: set to 0: PCOS association not replicated in Indian samples and largely BMI-mediated
panel.evidence: A is provisional risk-direction only. Supports A: Liu 2017 meta-analysis (PMID 28826396, A vs T OR 1.36), Li 2013 (PMID 23840863), Sri Lankan study (PMID 32050935, AA over-represented in cases), South Indian trend (OR 1.30, 0.83-2.02, not significant). Does not support: Cai 2014 (PMID 24466303, no overall association after BMI adjustment); Zhang & Yu 2024 (PMID 39143730) reports T vs A OR 1.19 with wording that conflicts with the other meta-analyses.
panel.indian_evidence: Gujarat 62 PCOS/52 controls (Chaudhary 2023, PMC10500741): T vs A OR 0.90 (0.43-1.83), not significant. South India 100 PCOS/70 controls (Naghshband & Malini 2022, doi 10.1186/s43042-022-00236-6): not associated with PCOS; linked to BMI, fasting glucose, testosterone.
panel.note: dbSNP ref T, alt A, chr16:53786615 (GRCh38), intron. A is the usual BMI/obesity risk allele. A/T SNPs can be reported on either strand, so check the coded allele in each paper. Not used in score.

panel.weight_source: set to 0: evidence is dominant-model, population- and BMI-subgroup-specific; cannot be converted to a per-allele weight
panel.evidence: Supports T: Indian lean-women study (PMID 19211708; CT+TT linked to PCOS in lean women, p=0.004; fasting insulin, HOMA-IR); Saudi study (Daghestani 2020, PMC7526013; T freq 0.306 vs 0.174); Indian GWAS-variant study PMID 31837364.
panel.conflicts: No association in Kashmiri women (PMID 34912452) and South Indian women (Thangavelu); Chinese family TDT null (PMC3118173).

panel.evidence: PMID 31837364 (Indian, 253 cases/308 controls; effect allele not stated in abstract); PMC4346843 meta-analysis (C vs T).
panel.conflicts: Papers use different strand/notation (T/C, A/G); Han Chinese TDT null.
panel.note: Normalise strand and genome build before assigning a risk allele.

dropped.reason: No convincing variant-specific PCOS association paper found.
